problems.title: Acute inclination of a falling line
problems.question: Find the sine of the acute angle between y=-x+3 and the x-axis.
problems.idea: The magnitude of the slope is tan of the acute inclination.

problems.title: Reciprocal Pythagorean factors
problems.question: Evaluate (1+tan²19°)(1-sin²19°).
problems.idea: Replace each factor with a cosine expression.
steps: The two factors multiply to 1 wherever cosθ≠0.

problems.title: Recover squared trigonometric values
problems.question: Find (1+sin²β)/(1+cos²β) if tanβ=2.
problems.idea: Use tan²β=sin²β/cos²β.
steps: The ratio sin²:cos² is 4:1, so the squares are 4/5 and 1/5.

problems.title: Equal squares give two linear branches
problems.question: Find the root sum of (2x+1)²=(x+2)².
problems.idea: Take both signs when equating the unsquared expressions.

problems.title: The stated bound does not fix both absolute-value signs
problems.question: Simplify √(a²-2a+1)+√(4a²-12a+9) for a≤3/2.
problems.idea: Split again at a=1.
steps: The two formulas agree at a=1, but neither single formula covers all stated a.
problems.note: The listed answer 2-a requires the extra lower bound a≥1. The source gives only a≤3/2.

problems.title: Definition of a monic quadratic
problems.question: When is ax²+bx+c=0 a monic quadratic?
problems.idea: A monic polynomial has leading coefficient 1.
formulas: Monic means coefficient of highest power equals 1.
steps: For this quadratic the leading coefficient is a.
Thus a=1; b,c can be arbitrary.

problems.title: An integer system becomes a product of one
problems.question: Count integer triples solving y+z=10+x, yz=10x+1.
problems.idea: Eliminate x and factor.
steps: Thus (y,z)=(11,11) with x=12, or (9,9) with x=8.

problems.title: Sine from triangle area
problems.question: For A=(-2,0),B=(3,0),C=(0,4), find sinACB.
problems.idea: Compare determinant area with the sine area formula.
steps: The determinant magnitude is 20. AC=√20=2√5 and BC=5.

problems.title: Count roots through the absolute value
problems.question: How many roots has x²+4x²/|x|=199²?
problems.idea: Set t=|x|, keeping t>0.
steps: The equation is t²+4t=199². Its only positive root is t=√39605-2.
This gives the two distinct real x-values ±t.

problems.title: The coefficients are also the roots
problems.question: Nonzero b,c are roots of x²+bx+c=0. Find c.
problems.idea: Use the sum and product of roots.
steps: The sum equation then gives c=-2b=-2.

problems.title: A printed square creates a cubic equation
problems.question: Find the sum of squared real roots of x²+(√x-2)²-4=0.
problems.idea: Set t=√x≥0 and preserve the printed x².
steps: One root is t=0, giving x=0. The cubic t³+t-4 strictly increases and has exactly one positive root u.
Thus the other x-root is u², and the requested squared-root sum is u⁴.
problems.answer: u⁴≈3.614106, with u the unique positive root of u³+u-4=0.
problems.note: None of the printed integer choices follows from the equation as printed. Replacing the initial x² by x would be a different equation and would give the listed value 4.

problems.title: Include the linear parameter case
problems.question: How many integer m make mx²+x+m=0 have exactly one real root, counting a repeated root once?
problems.idea: Check m=0 before using a quadratic discriminant.
steps: At m=0 the equation is x=0 and has one root.
Every nonzero integer m gives Δ≤-3, so no real roots.
The repeated-root values m=±1/2 are not integers.

problems.title: Two explicit roots control a parameter
problems.question: Find a so both roots of x²-(2a+4)x+8a=0 exceed 2.
problems.idea: Factor the polynomial.
steps: The first already exceeds 2; the second does so iff a>1.
problems.note: A repeated root at a=2 is also greater than 2. If distinct roots were additionally required, exclude a=2; that restriction is not in the question.

problems.title: Reduce an expression using the root equation
problems.question: x₁,x₂ solve √3x²+√2x-1=0. Find √3x₁²+(√2+1)x₁+x₂+√6/3.
problems.idea: Use the root equation and Vieta’s sum.

problems.title: Root ratio and Vieta
problems.question: The roots of x²+20x+a=0 have ratio 7:3. Find a.
problems.idea: Write the roots as 7t,3t.

problems.title: Match a factorization’s coefficients
problems.question: x²-bx+6=(x-2)(x+c). Find b+c.
problems.idea: Expand the given factors.
steps: The x coefficient gives -b=-5, so b=5.

problems.title: Absolute difference of two squares
problems.question: If x²+y²=6 and xy=1, find |x²-y²|.
problems.idea: Square the target.
steps: The absolute value is its nonnegative square root.

problems.title: A repeated inner root reduces the count
problems.question: Count distinct roots of |x²-6|x|+8|=1.
problems.idea: Set t=|x|≥0 and solve both sign cases.
steps: For u=1, t²-6t+7=0 gives t=3±√2, both positive.
For u=-1, (t-3)²=0 gives just one distinct t=3.
Each of these three positive t-values gives x=±t.

problems.title: Travel-time difference in hours
problems.question: A car covers 90 km 18 minutes faster than a bus and travels 10 km/h faster. Find bus speed.
problems.idea: Write both times using bus speed v>0.

problems.title: Distance after motion along a 120-degree angle
problems.question: Two objects leave A along rays 120° apart at 4 and 5 km/h. Find their distance after 2 hours.
problems.idea: Use their travelled distances in the cosine rule.

problems.title: Bisector length and a split opposite side
problems.question: A 6 cm angle bisector splits the opposite side into 2 and 3 cm. Find the longest side.
problems.idea: Combine the bisector theorem and its length formula.

problems.title: The sine rule chooses the valid triangle angle
problems.question: In the shown triangle AB=6√2,BC=6,C=45°. Find tanA.
problems.idea: Find sinA and check the supplementary alternative.
steps: A could algebraically be 30° or 150°, but 150°+45° exceeds 180°.

problems.title: Chord midpoints recover the third chord
problems.question: The angle between chords AB,BC is 30°. Their midpoint distance is 4 cm. Find the circle radius.
problems.idea: The midpoint segment is half AC.

problems.title: Compare the largest squared side
problems.question: Classify a triangle with sides 7,8,11 cm.
problems.idea: Use the converse of the cosine rule.
formulas: If c²>a²+b², the angle opposite c is obtuse.

problems.title: A base-angle bisector in a 20-degree apex triangle
problems.question: An isosceles triangle has base √3 and opposite apex angle 20°. Find a bisector from a base vertex.
problems.idea: Use the smaller triangle containing the base.
formulas: Base angles are 80°; sine rule in the bisector triangle.
steps: The base vertex is split into 40°, and the other base angle remains 80°. The angle at the bisector foot is 60°.
